- History is rebuilt only when it's not current (`refresh.go:336`). Seed is gated on the commit, and the code index on `semanticRefreshNeeded`.

- `AnnotateUnifiedFactResults` builds a lookup map over the whole corpus for every query (`guard.go:39-42`).
- A dead `docs/embeddings/vectors.bin` (967 KB) is left over from the removed semantic retrieval.
- A `quarantine-stray-facts-*` directory sits at the brain root.
- **So what:** cleanup. Fine once the corpus is about 2.8k facts.

Survey complete — three explorers plus Brain recall, verified against current source. The short version: **the worst problems on this machine are a stale installed binary, not the code; the biggest code wins are hot paths that re-read the whole fact store several times per call; and about 40k LOC of removable surface remains, led by the pattern subsystem, the `inspect` group, and multi-repo workspaces.**

## 0. Do first: your local brain runs an old build

`~/.local/bin/entire-brain` was built Oct 26, before the proposal removal, the MCP removal, and the flat fact store (Nov 2). That one fact explains most of the noise:

- The phantom `proposals: 59329` and the `mcp` capability come from the old binary. Current source writes neither.
- The local store is still 176 per-branch `facts.ndjson` files: 24,735 lines but only **~2,834 unique facts**. Every `recall`/`brief` parses and merges all 24,735 lines. A rebuild plus one `refresh` migrates to the flat store and cuts every fact read ~9x.
- The "manifest behind the store" warning is 7 staged candidates the old binary does not count; fixed Oct 26 in source.

Two real operational gaps remain even with a new build: the watcher defers full refresh while the worktree is dirty, so in Conductor it effectively never runs; and the brain is keyed by origin remote and shared across all 8 worktrees, so the "seed is stale" warning can never clear for more than one of them. Both deserve fixes (refresh despite dirty tree from the committed side; ancestor-based seed freshness).

## 1. Faster: stop re-reading the store

- `recall` merges the full store up to **three times** per query (`facts_read_cmd.go:103`, `integrity.go:298`, and `blind_spot.go:51` on empty results) and spawns ~4 git subprocesses. BM25 is recomputed from scratch per query — facts never touch SQLite (the FTS index is history/docs only). Fine at 2.8k facts, but one shared merge plus a digest-keyed postings sidecar would make it O(small).
- `brief` is the slowest path: it runs the full non-lightweight status (graph subprocess, another full store merge, retrieval audit at `agent_surface.go:4508-4669`), then loads the store *again* for its facts section, and for some task wordings reads up to 2,500 repo files. Use the lightweight status and reuse the already-loaded facts.
- `refresh` does 3–4 full store loads plus a whole-file rewrite, and rebuilds the doc index every run even when nothing changed.
- The vitality receipt costs a `git rev-parse` plus a locked append on every recall, and by design never affects ranking. Either feed it into ranking or stop paying for it.

## 2. Smarter: quality bugs and missing priors

- **Live quality bug in brief's history section**: the raw scan reads derived indexes (`docs/index.json`, `entities/index.json` — the latter matches almost any identifier), and raw hits are merged *ahead of* the FTS-ranked history, pushing ranked results out (`agent_surface.go:1709`, `:5495`). There are also eval-tuned hacks in there (an "ultron" exclusion, a +100 boost for "LIMIT" queries). Skip derived dirs and merge indexed results first.
- `recall` has no recency prior and no decay — the 90-day half-life exists but only on `query`, never on `recall`. Confidence is 1.00 on 95% of facts, so it carries no signal. The flat +4 bonus for closed-negative facts applies to ~17% of the corpus regardless of relevance.
- Near-duplicate facts below the old confidence threshold stay active as cross-linked pairs; 1,910 active records carry `related_ids` and reach recall un-collapsed. Collapsing those pairs is probably the single best relevance lever.
- `--expand` spawns an LLM on every call because its cache path is `""` (`facts_commands.go:82`) — results are never saved.

## 3. Removal candidates, ranked

| Candidate | Size | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| Compact brief v1/v2/v3 serializers — no flag or caller can reach them | ~1.4k LOC + 2.9k test | Delete outright |
| `semantic_relevance.go` — zero callers | 255 LOC | Delete |
| `factmerge` confidence threshold / `ApplyActions` — test-only; production reconcile ignores confidence; comments still cite the removed `facts review` | ~80 LOC + tests | Delete, with the `--confidence` flag |
| Proposal/branch leftovers: `Proposals` counters, a `"proposals"` help entry in `root.go:250`, always-zero branch-count prints, and legacy-dir cleanup that can never delete orphan `proposals.ndjson`/`vitality`/`embeddings` (retained forever) | ~small code, 5.8 MB disk | Delete fields; teach cleanup the orphan names |
| `inspect` group — 16 verbs over a local copy of the code graph Brain no longer owns; `search-graph` is literally the same function as `inspect code`; agentsetup already points agents at `entire graph` | ~13k LOC | Delegate `context`/`impact`/`tests` to Graph, drop the rest |
| Pattern subsystem — episodes/corpus feed brief, but themes, lessons, conventions, deep dossiers, skill synthesis, and cross-repo families are opt-in agent runs | ~5k of 16.4k LOC | Quarantine or drop the opt-in half |
| Three browse UIs: `dash` (TUI), `viz` (web UI + Node/Playwright CI jobs), `inspect graph-ui` (static HTML) | ~2–3k LOC + CI | Drop `graph-ui`; pick one of `dash`/`viz` |
| Multi-repo `workspace` — 13 subcommands mirroring the single-repo ones | ~5.7k LOC | Product call; removing it also takes the cross-repo pattern code |
| Hidden eval/bench harnesses compiled into the shipped binary (`memories eval*`, `history-eval*`, `bench`) | ~4k LOC | Move to `tools/` or a build tag |
| `memory abstract` — ships disabled; `purgeSessionAbstracts` is already dead | 2.6k LOC | Remove or commit to it |
| Migration/tombstone code (legacy layouts, `init-agents`/`publish` tombstones, deprecated no-op flags, `vsearch` alias) | ~1.5k LOC | Sweep after a version cutoff |
| `benchmarks/` (12 MB of historical experiment archives) and 4.9 MB of images in `docs/` | 17 MB | Move out of the repo |

Structurally, `internal/cli` is still a 183-file, 87k-LOC flat package; the extracted `command/*` shells hold only ~7% and call back into the monolith through `Deps` seams. The removals above would shrink four of its five largest files.

## Bounds from recorded decisions (so we don't relitigate)

- Embedder/vector reinstatement was explicitly rejected (trail #278, cgo stripped in #416; facts beat embedded chunks 12.6–14x on useful-tokens). "Smarter" should mean better lexical ranking and dedup, not embeddings.
- Topic-specific ranking bonuses were removed after a flat 23-task offline comparison — any ranking change (recency prior, pair-collapsing, dropping the +4 bonus) should go through the same eval harness before landing.
- `ENTIRE_BRAIN_NO_EGRESS` is a deliberate keep.
- One recorded bug I checked is already fixed: pulled teammate facts do reach the store now (`hosted_sync.go:506-542`).

If you want an order: rebuild + refresh today; then the brief history-merge bug and recall's triple-merge (small diffs, immediate effect); then the `inspect`-to-Graph delegation and the pattern quarantine as the two big LOC reductions. Happy to turn any slice of this into a Linear issue or start on the quick deletions.
